scope: Static, non-executing verification of the contemporaneous third-party installer linked by the post instalador-da-boost. The executable itself is not republished in this repository.

vendorPageEvidence.provenanceQualification: The exact post-linked boost-consulting.com executable URL has no status-200 CDX row. The same first-party product page survived on both vendor hostnames, and the exact filename survived under the later boostpro.com hostname. This is strong vendor-lineage evidence, not proof that both hostname payloads were byte-identical.

waybackCapture.cdxRecordLengthQualification: CDX length describes the archived record and is not the decoded HTTP entity length.

payloadValidation.detectedType: PE32 executable (GUI) Intel 80386, for MS Windows, Nullsoft Installer self-extracting archive

pe.authenticode: No embedded Authenticode signature was present.

payloadValidation.extraction: unar identified NSIS but failed to parse the archive; no embedded-resource inventory or screenshot comparison was possible with the installed static tools.

restorationDisposition: The installer is a verified contemporaneous first-party-vendor artifact, but not one of the three missing author-created ZIP downloads and not either missing author screenshot. Its bytes are intentionally not shipped. boostconfig1.png and boostinstaller2.png remain unrecovered.
